messages:
Marta: Quick brainwave  Retro LAN & Pizza night? Bring consoles, laptops, cables. Basement lab 7pm this Friday. Low-key, BYO controller. Thoughts?
Ken: 100% yes. Ill bring an old PS2 and a pile of controllers. :video_game:
Samir: Love it. I can stand up a little LAN switch (8-port) and bring some Cat6 cables.
Ivy: In! Ill supply the pizza order spreadsheet (veg, vegan, GF options).
Leo: Can we have a projector for Smash / Mario Kart? I have one we can borrow.
Marta: Projector + cables noted. Also a reminder  basement has limited outlets, bring power strips.
devops-bot: Heads up: temporary DHCP range for basement VLAN needs reservation. Tag @devops to approve.
Samir: Tagging @devops  will request a small DHCP pool (10.0.42.100-110) and low-priority QoS so no streaming floods the net.
Ken: RSVP format to keep it tidy: `Yes / #people / pizza (Y/N) + dietary note`
Ivy: Yes / 2 / Y / 1 vegan slice pls.
Leo: Yes / +1 / Y / no prefs.
Marta: Maybe / 1 / N / cant eat late.
Samir: Yes / 1 / N / bringing switch & cables. Also can someone bring ethernet tape to label ports?
Ivy: Ill bring labels + sharpies.
calendar-bot: Event created  "Retro LAN & Pizza Night"  Fri 2024-11-08 19:00  Location: Basement Lab (alt: Conf Room C). RSVP in thread.
Ken: Also small house rules: no online match downloads during the event, keep noise respectful after 10pm, and return borrowed gear.
Marta: Agreed. We'll do a short setup crew at 6:30 (power + tables). Volunteers?
Samir: I can do setup 6:15-6:45  network check and switch config.
Ivy: Ill do setup for tables/labels.
Leo: Cleanup volunteer after, I got trash & recyclables.
facilities: Note: Basement Lab occupancy limit is 30. Please avoid open flames and return furniture to original spots. If you bring speakers, keep volume reasonable.
Marta: Thanks @facilities. Pizza order: I'll post a quick Google form tomorrow AM to collect slices. Prefer to do half from Tony's + one vegan place.
Ken: Can we have a 10-min "retro showoff" at 8:15? Bring any weird hardware or mods.
Ivy: Ooh yes, Ill bring my modded controller and an LED arcade stick.
Samir: Ill set the router with static route for local play and block heavy ports during the event (we can relax after 10).
Marta: Perfect. If anyone wants to stream clips to the projector (local only), DM me for the local share creds.
Ken: :raised_hands: hype. See you Friday night.
Ivy: Pizza form link incoming tomorrow  will ping here.
Marta: Sweet. If turnout is big we can shift to Conf Room C as backup. Poll at 3pm Friday if weather/trades affect basement access.
Samir: Counting on low-latency chaos. :smile:
